title: Seven-day search plan
purpose: Produce an actionable seven-day plan the candidate carries out themselves to close gaps, strengthen evidence and apply responsibly.

inputs.name: matchTable
inputs.description: The requirement-to-evidence table, including the gaps.

inputs.name: preferences
inputs.description: Preferred roles, location preference and permitted contact preferences.

outputs.name: sevenDayPlan
outputs.description: Seven entries, one per day numbered 1 to 7, each with one to four concrete actions.

steps: Choose the two or three biggest gaps or opportunities from the match table.
Spread small, concrete actions across seven days: learning, portfolio work, resume review, practice questions and finding further postings to read.
Keep each day achievable in a couple of hours and say what finished looks like.
Include one review day where the candidate approves final documents before using them anywhere.
Respect the candidate's location and contact preferences.
constraints: The plan has exactly seven days, numbered 1 to 7.
Every action is something the candidate does; the agent never applies, emails or contacts anyone.
No scraping, automated applications or use of account credentials.
Do not promise interviews, offers or timelines for employment.
